༄༅/ /zhing sgrub zin bris kyi lhan thabs nyung bsdus bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// zhing sgrub zin bris kyi lhan thabs nyung bsdus bzhugs so//

na mo a mi ta bhā ya/ zhing sgrub bsnyen pa sogs kyi sta gon rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum sogs ni zin bris ltar la/ ༈ rang gzhan gshin don sta gon rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum la/ rgyas pa ni zhing bkod zhal thang bshams pa'i mdun/ mchod stegs steng du 'bru'i tshom bu 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su sku gzugs bzhag /g.yas su rnam rgyal bum pa rdzas ldan kha rgyan gang 'dzom/ g.yon du las bum/ mdun du zlum gtor rgyan ldan/ de mdun sman raka gtor gsum dang zhing skyong gtor ma/ bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid sna bdun 'bur ma'am ni tsaka li nyer spyod kyi gong nas phred bkram mam 'dzugs pa gang bdes mdzes par brgyan/ de mthar mchod pa sna bdun bsham/ ༈ 'bring po zlum gtor rtse la 'od dpag tsaka li btsugs/ bum pa gnyis dang sman rag gtor gsum/ mchod pa sna bdun bshams pas 'thus/ ༈ bsdus pa mdun bskyed rten rin po che'i snod 'brus bkang steng rdo rje bzhag /bum pa gtor ma gang 'dzom bsham/ thog mar sngon 'gro ni cog rdog bshams la/ rin chen snod du sogs khā hi gsum nas gatstsha gatstsha yis phyi rol dor/ na mo: dkon mchog gsum sogs 'od dpag las byang tshang bar bsnyen pa'i mtshams bar 'don nas/ rang nyid sems dpa' 'jig rten dbang phyug dkar// zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po thal sbyar dang// 'og mas shel phreng dang ni pad dkar 'dzin// thor tshugs dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan// sku smad padma'i nang nub skyil krung bzhugs// thugs kar mdun du bskyed pa lta bu yi// 'od dpag med pa gtso 'khor gsum po dang*// bde chen zhing bkod yongs su rdzogs par gsal// gtso bo'i thugs kar zla steng hrīḥyig mthar// a mi dhe wa'i sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor// de las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa// mdzod spu nas thon nam mkha' khyab par 'phros// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad mchod// rgyal ba'i byin rlabs bsdus nas rang la thim// 'gro ba sems can kun gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs// bde ba can du skye ba'i skal ldan gyur// yul phyogs phyi snod bde chen zhing du gyur// nang bcud sems can 'od dpag med pa'i sku

/yab yum sras dang sems dpa' sems ma dang*// sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyur// sngags sgra sgrog pas 'khor ba dong nas sprugs// gzugs can gzugs med sems can thams cad kun// 'od dpag med pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur// oṃ a mi dhe wa hrī: brgya'am ci mang bzla'o// rang gi thugs ka'i sngags phreng 'od zer las// hrīḥyig dmar po bye ru'i phreng ba ltar// zhal nas thon cing mdun bskyed zhal du zhugs// thugs ka'i sngags phreng la thim thugs rgyud bskul// de las hrīḥyig dmar po'i phreng ba byon// lte ba nas thon rang gi lte bar thim// thugs kar thim pas byin rlabs dngos grub thob// mgal me'i 'khor lo bzhin du 'khor ba las// bar du 'khor tshe 'od zer sna tshogs pa// nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing du 'phros// sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa'i sku la thim// sku gsung thugs rgyud mnyes pa'i mchod par gyur// sku las 'od dpag med pa'i sku che phra// gsung las sngags phreng hrīḥyig dmar po dang*// thugs las rdo rje dmar po rtse lnga pa/ kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin du byon// bdag mdun rnams la sib sib thim par gyur// hrī: brgya rtsa'am ci mang bzla'o// de nas bdag mdun bum pa gnyis la/ mdun bskyed bum bskyed thugs ka ru// zla steng hrīḥdamar gzungs kyis bskor// rang gi thugs ka'i sngags phreng 'phros// mdun bskyed zhal zhugs thugs rgyud bskul// gzungs sngags g.yas su 'khor ba las// 'od zer sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'phros// sbyin bdag thog drangs 'gro kun gyi// sdig sgrib nyes ltung bag chags kun// ba mor nyi zer phog ltar dag /bum lha'i sku las bdud rtsi bab// bum pa bdud rtsis gang bar gyur// na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te/ a mi ta bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ buddhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ a mi te/

a mi todbha we/ a mi ta saṃ bha we/ a mi ta bi krānte/ a mi ta gā mi nī/ ga ga na kīrti ka re sarba kle sha kṣa yaṃ ka ri swā hā/ zhes gzungs ring ci mang bzla/ las bum la/ las bum nang du rta mgrin dmar// thod dbyug zhags 'dzin 'dor thabs bzhugs// sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas// bum pa bdud rtsis gang bar gyur// oṃ ha ya grī wa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ nyer gcig bdun sogs bzla'o// de nas bde smon rgyas pa'am/ shes bya ma'am/ phyogs dus rgyal ba'am/ bzang spyod bcas thams cad tshar na dang*/ ma tshar na 'don res bya/ de lta bu'i cho ga bsdus pa tshar gcig las rung tsam las/ gzhung rkyang ni rang don thugs dam yin zhing*/ gzhan don la bdag mdun bum gsum tshang ma dang*/ bde smon rnams ma tshang na mi rung*/ gzhung tshe 'gugs dang sngags sogs do nub tshar gcig /gshin don la ni mi dgos/ de yang gson po'i rim gro la tshe chog byed na tshe gzungs dang dbang rdzas dbang ltar las bde smon ma thon na mi dgos so// sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
